gates.reason: Inspected capability-based hiding of server-only and Enterprise navigation; tests cover denied and allowed Enterprise capability states without exercising a privileged operation.
Layout tests do not implement detectors, parsers, recommendation claims, arithmetic, historical signals, or validated fix snippets.
Test-only rendering and interaction code is not a production hot path or shipped surface.

Inspected client-side capability gating, Enterprise navigation visibility, dynamic rendered text, links, callbacks, and SPA navigation; no executable HTML interpolation, secret egress, privileged write, or injection sink is present.
The component formats navigation and caller-supplied counts but does not detect, parse, calculate recommendations, emit provenance, or provide validated fix snippets.

Inspected render-time filtering, set construction, event-listener lifecycle, and imports; work is bounded by the static navigation collection, the keyboard listener is cleaned up, and icons use per-module imports.

Inspected policy-write denial coverage, dangerous-command rendering/copy behavior, and permission evidence routing; denied capability remains copy-only and command evidence is copied as text rather than executed.

Re-derived fixture-backed KPI counts, session joins, dangerous-command evidence, permission changes, timestamps, sorting, and pagination assertions; claims trace to explicit fixture fields and are reproducible.

Inspected large-table and re-render coverage; tests verify initial row caps, reachable pagination, risk-first ordering, persistence across identity-only re-renders, and reset on genuine filter changes.
